output.lesson: BASS and BASS-II burned small solid-material samples in microgravity while varying oxygen, airflow, and fuel type; the event description reports no specific failure. The tests help show how these conditions affect whether a flame on a solid survives, informing material flammability limits and suppression guidance. BASS studies how realistic materials burn and how an inert gas can extinguish flames, while BASS-II examines ignition, flame spread, and extinction in low-speed flows [bass] [bass-ii]. That knowledge can help crews design safer vehicles and fire responses for future Moon and Mars missions.
